تستعمروا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْمِرُوا (tastaʕmirū) /tas.taʕ.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
# تُسْتَعْمَرُوا (tustaʕmarū) /tus.taʕ.ma.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
